title: Primary Dexterity
summary: Primary Dexterity is a Primary Arcane that on melee kill increases primary weapon damage for 20 seconds and stacks up to 6 times. At max rank, it also passively increases Melee Combo Counter duration.
extract:
Primary Dexterity is a Primary Arcane that on melee kill increases primary weapon damage for 20 seconds and stacks up to 6 times. At max rank, it also passively increases Melee Combo Counter duration.
Can be sold for  1,000.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for defeating Acolytes in The Steel Path.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
The damage bonus stacks additively with other damage mods like  Serration.
When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.
Companions can also activate the melee kill condition if they are using a melee weapon such as Claws, Deconstructor or any of the Hound weapons.

Tips
If players would rather prefer to focus on melee and not on shooting targets, they can opt to equip this Arcane and  Secondary Dexterity, both at max rank, on their ranged weapons simply to provide their passive melee combo counter buffs that grant up to 15 seconds.
When equipped on an Archgun, the combo duration buff will still apply even if the archgun is never deployed, allowing for bonus combo duration without sacrificing your primary weapon's Arcane slot.
